about: The secreta of the formulary “Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, we dutifully worship You, humbly entreating You by the prayers of blessed Joseph, Spouse of the Mother of Your Son, Jesus Christ our Lord, in whose honor we offer these sacrifices of praise, that You protect Your gifts within us. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
